truth_boundary: Component CI, release provenance, historical operational code and research evidence are separate qualification domains. No one domain substitutes for integrated product acceptance, connected Demo evidence or profitability.

evidence.fresh_f13_f17_adversarial: 5/5 violated properties; reproduced in three consecutive runs
evidence.fresh_f19: OMS FILLED/1 while portfolio remained 0; next cycle approved a second BUY
evidence.fresh_f20: same intent_id with changed quantity/price returned the original record instead of conflict
evidence.fresh_f21: broker CASH_MISMATCH -900 was detected but canonical planning still approved a BUY using internal cash
evidence.fresh_f26: same account-less readonly evidence allowed the bounded Paper mutation drill to PASS against two different broker-double account ids

canonical_product_shape.paper_runtime: LongOnlyMomentumStrategy + PreTradeRiskEngine + durable OMS/mutations + portfolio + optional fill accounting + readiness evaluator
canonical_product_shape.paper_strategy_contract: LongOnlyMomentumStrategy is a deterministic paper E2E validation strategy and is not presented as profitable

findings.summary: Two workers can both reach external submit for the same outbox intent.
findings.required: winner-only transactional mutation claim; loser GET/reconcile only

findings.summary: Concurrent cancel/replace can duplicate external mutation calls.
findings.required: winner-only amendment claim plus ambiguity-safe reconciliation

findings.summary: Pending/outbox orders do not reserve cash/notional.
findings.required: durable reservations included in every new-risk admission

findings.summary: Replay bar time can become an optimistic operational freshness clock.
findings.required: typed REPLAY versus OPERATIONAL clock contract

findings.summary: Later HALT/readiness failure does not revoke an already queued risk-increasing dispatch.
findings.required: authoritative final interlock immediately before every external risk-increasing mutation

findings.summary: Approved risk decision is not immutably bound to exact intent economics.
findings.required: immutable RiskAuthorization bound to intent/economics/policy/context revisions

findings.summary: Risk-increasing replace is not re-admitted against current limits.
findings.observed: replace target 100000 reached broker double under cap 110
findings.required: new admission for every risk-increasing amendment

findings.summary: Planning another symbol can lack authoritative prices for existing exposure.
findings.required: fresh whole-portfolio valuation snapshot

findings.summary: ProductConfig accepts target_quantity=0 although strategy construction rejects it.
findings.required: one positive-quantity configuration contract

findings.summary: Factual execution can persist while accounting projection fails and state diverges.
findings.required: immutable execution inbox plus restart-safe projection state machine

findings.summary: Same persisted history can replay under a different arbitrary opening cash.
findings.required: immutable account/session genesis plus explicit cash-flow events

findings.summary: Rejected unauthenticated frame digest can enter dedup before validation and an exact replay can reach accounting.
findings.required: validated/authenticated provenance before accounting authority

findings.summary: Enabled operational risk limits can be silently skipped when optional measurements are missing.
findings.required: missing observation for enabled limit = explicit fail-closed reason

findings.summary: Invalid final bar timestamp can raise naive/aware TypeError instead of quality FAIL.
findings.required: deterministic ready=false evidence for invalid inputs

findings.summary: Walk-forward qualifier can return qualified=true with zero trades and zero active windows.
findings.required: non-vacuous minimum trades/windows/regimes/sample/cost/OOS policy

findings.summary: Canonical signal path can approve a BUY from data rejected by market-data quality validation.
findings.required: validated operational data snapshot required before strategy/risk

findings.summary: Material broker-returned order-economics divergence can be accepted as ACK.
findings.required: strict response identity/economics validation; otherwise UNCERTAIN

findings.summary: Reconciliation can replace established broker order id without explicit replace lineage.
findings.required: immutable primary broker id or proven replaces/replaced_by chain

findings.summary: Immediate submit fill updates OMS but not portfolio before the next decision.
findings.required: submit/stream/backfill fills converge through one durable execution/accounting path before new risk

findings.summary: Same intent_id with changed economics can be treated as idempotent success.
findings.required: intent_id is immutable economic identity; divergent replay = INTENT_ID_CONFLICT

findings.summary: Known broker cash mismatch is diagnostic only and does not block new risk.
findings.observed: broker cash 100 versus internal cash 1000; CASH_MISMATCH -900 detected; BUY still approved
findings.required: durable financial-activity recovery and reconciled broker cash/equity as admission prerequisite

findings.summary: Canonical application has no integrated realtime feed, bar finalizer, gap repair or deterministic decision scheduler; PaperCycle accepts caller-supplied bars.
findings.required: authoritative live market-data service with durable watermarks and exactly-one decision per finalized bar

findings.summary: No canonical fresh instrument-spec/tick/lot/min-notional/status/margin normalization before risk authorization.
findings.required: normalized executable economics bound to fresh InstrumentSpec revision and revalidated before dispatch

findings.summary: V106 validates declared backup/restore evidence but does not create and restore a real trading-state backup.
findings.required: actual isolated backup->restore->semantic verification drill for all durable trading state

findings.summary: Canonical session/final dispatch is not bound to expected account, environment, credential generation and release identity.
findings.required: immutable BrokerIdentity verified by read-only preflight and bound through session/authorization/dispatch

findings.summary: External Paper readonly evidence originally lacked account identity and the bounded mutation drill could PASS against another account id.
findings.required: privacy-safe account fingerprint equality before any mutation; bounded repair PR #146

findings.summary: Historical Alpaca request defaults adjustment=all and omits asof, leaving frozen symbol/entity mapping dependent on current-day provider mapping.
findings.required: explicit asof/entity/universe/corporate-action policy in immutable dataset manifest

packaging_findings.summary: migrations/product/001-004 are absent from qualified wheel/sdist although core PostgreSQL migrate defaults reference them.
Canonical Bybit v119-v121 Python modules ship without corresponding root migration resources in wheel/sdist.
Installed console scripts are primarily engineering/audit tools; one supported product operator/service interface is absent.
Distributed source tests depend on omitted test helpers and do not self-reproduce from the sdist.
Release qualification does not clean-install the built wheel and prove packaged schema resources/bootstrap/offline self-test.

qualification_findings.summary: PR run metadata names branch head while default checkout tests the synthetic PR merge; both identities must be recorded separately when exact-head policy matters.
operational-readiness push workflow targets historical agent/schema108-paper-core-foundation instead of canonical main.

external_api_contracts_checked.alpaca_account_activities: Current Account Activities API includes cash-impacting activity types beyond FILL; canonical recovery is FILL-only.
external_api_contracts_checked.bybit_instruments: Current V5 instrument information publishes dynamic tick/lot/min-notional/status/leverage constraints required before executable order authorization.
external_api_contracts_checked.alpaca_historical_bars: Current API uses asof for entity/symbol mapping and defaults asof to current day; qualification requests must freeze it explicitly.
